title.en: Batas Pambansa Blg. 201  An Act Converting the Prenza Barangay High School in the Municipality of Marilao, Province of Bulacan, Into a National High School to Be Known as the Prenza National High School, and Appropriating Funds therefor.

title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển đổi Trường Trung học Prenza Barangay tại Thị trấn Marilao, Tỉnh Bulacan thành Trường Trung học Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Prenza Quốc gia
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนสถานะโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Prenza Barangay ในเทศบาล Marilao จังหวัด Bulacan เป็น โรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาแห่งชาติในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Prenza แห่งชาติ
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah Sekolah Menengah Prenza Barangay di Kotamadya Marilao, Provinsi Bulacan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Prenza Nasional
title.ms: Akta menukar status Sekolah Menengah Prenza Barangay di Perbandaran Marilao, Wilayah Bulacan kepada Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Prenza Kebangsaan

text.en:
The Prenza Barangay High School in the Municipality of Marilao, Province of Bulacan, is
converted into a national high school to be known as the Prenza National High School.

The amount of two hundred thousand pesos for the operation of the school shall be charged to
the appropriations authorized by Batas Pambansa Blg. 80 for the Ministry of Education and Culture intended
for new national schools: Provided, That the local government unit concerned shall continue to provide its
share in the cost of operating and maintaining said school: Provided, further, That thereafter, such sum as may
be necessary for its operation and maintenance shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: March 16, 1982
